title: Life Path Number 1: The Leader
name: The Leader
intro: Life Path 1 people are independent pioneers. They like to start things, make their own decisions and stand out from the crowd. Confident and driven, they inspire others with courage and new ideas.
love: In love, 1s need a partner who respects their freedom and cheers on their goals.
career: Entrepreneur, manager, inventor, athlete or any role where they can lead.
